# Keeping the Map Alive

AI tools and model capabilities change quickly. Treat this book as a living
resource and revisit it as the landscape evolves.

## Maintaining the quarterly Hotplate

Review the landscape and update the Hotplate on its quarterly release cycle.
Keep dated observations so readers can distinguish current signals from older
snapshots.

## Contributing and continuing

Contribute useful observations and corrections, and follow the source material
linked throughout the repository. Choose next steps that fit your role:

- **Solo developers and indie builders:** assemble a small stack you can run
  and control.
- **Team leads:** introduce agentic workflows with clear boundaries and
  operational visibility.
- **Researchers and evaluators:** compare systems with appropriate benchmarks
  and current evidence.

The most valuable skill is learning to assemble and control a stack that
serves your needs.
